repo.description:
### Impact

`ReviewableQueuedPostSerializer` unconditionally included `payload["raw_email"]` for posts that arrived via incoming email. Category moderation group members reaching the review queue could therefore read the full inbound email source (headers, sender trace, MUA, body) without being in `view_raw_email_allowed_groups` - the trust boundary that gates the dedicated raw-email endpoint.

### Patch

The serializer now redacts `raw_email` from the rendered payload unless the current user is in `view_raw_email_allowed_groups`. The frontend also hides the click affordance on the envelope icon for users without raw-email access, and a new `Guardian#can_view_raw_emails?` deduplicates the group check across callers.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to the patched version.
repo.summary: Category queue reviewers can read raw incoming emails from queued posts
